predictions.rationale: Primary class representing an Activity Diagram in the classic ArgoUML UI package; central for creation, persistence and behaviour of the diagram.
Equivalent core-module implementation for Activity Diagram (activity2); key for newer SPL variant.
Graph model that defines nodes/edges for Activity Diagrams; directly supports editing semantics.
Graph model counterpart in activity2 module; essential for workflow of Activity Diagrams in that variant.
Initialisation class that registers the Activity Diagram type with factories and menu actions.
Renderer that converts model elements into Figs for the Activity Diagram; crucial for visual presentation.
Rendering support for Activity Diagrams in activity2 module; parallels classic renderer.
Handles automatic layout of Activity Diagram elements; refines user workflow depiction.
UI action that allows users to create a new Activity Diagram from menus/toolbars.
Factory producing property panels specific to Activity Diagrams; supports editing of diagram properties.
